dimensions.evidenceA: Matthew names the country of the Gergesenes.
dimensions.evidenceB: Mark names the country of the Gadarenes.
dimensions.label: Region

evidence.observation: Two people possessed by demons meet Jesus in the country of the Gergesenes.
One man with an unclean spirit meets Jesus in the country of the Gadarenes.

record.tension: The two accounts differ in the number of people presented and in the name of the region.
record.title: Who meets Jesus among the tombs, and where?
